summary: Implemented a separate integer-tick price-time FIFO limit order book with partial fills, crossing orders, resting-price execution, and exact zero-fee cash/inventory accounting. All 15 tests pass, including a 1,500-order independent matching oracle. Regenerated results include a six-order trace and 1,000 synthetic orders with zero checked invariant violations. Existing simulator interfaces and negative policy-equity comparison are preserved.
